source_fields: All values are selected from existing originals or explicitly marked local checks; original paths are omitted
full_audit_bytes: Only allowlisted terminal/STOP/one-shot/reservation audit JSON are included as exact UTF-8 strings, enabling original SHA256 checks. No scientific raw is included.
redacted_projections: Other original SHA256 values cannot be recomputed from redacted fields. They are provenance links rather than authentication or standalone proof of original contents.
identity_limit: Aliases preserve locally checked graph relationships, but actual PID/starttime/PPID/UID consistency cannot be independently rechecked after redaction.
registry_limit: Registry and exclusion values are withheld. A recipient cannot repeat noncollision/exclusion or seed/event-hierarchy checks.
hash_limit: Hashes of private originals disclose correlation identifiers and byte lengths. They do not disclose raw contents or replace access to originals.
